name: price_volume_mix
title: Price, volume and mix bridge, prior year to current year
purpose: Revenue change from the prior year to the current year split into volume, mix and price effects per product; the three effects add up to the change (a bridge check).
limitations: Template of the rule-of-thumb-model plugin: the order lines are generated by make_data.py (seed 20261125).

Volume effect = (total units CY - total units PY) x mix PY x price PY; mix effect = total units CY x (mix CY - mix PY) x price PY; price effect = units CY x (price CY - price PY). Per product they add up to revenue CY - revenue PY.
Prices are average revenue per unit of each period.

notes.text: A product with no units in one period has price 0 there (IFERROR); its revenue then shows as price effect (new product) or as volume and mix (discontinued product), and the bridge still adds up.
A period code other than PY and CY is outside the bridge: the raw-total checks still hold, the contract's allowed values refuse it at landing.
